geometry_observation.admission: strict outward interval signs for F_1 at both quantized endpoints; fail if unresolved

prediction_inputs: support, declared independent scales, geometric interval, origin, perturbation; no source coefficient or reserved response
reserved_observable: all eleven components of d^2(delta x)/d tau^2 at tau=0, for the linearized joint nodal law
horizon: initial tangent derivative only; no positive-time or finite-amplitude trajectory
independent_response: mpmath at 95 decimal places; differentiate full incoming current sums along independently assembled nodal phase velocities
acceptance: inference returns bounded coefficient interval containing the known source coefficient
inferred lower coefficient bound is strictly positive, excluding epsilon=0 within this family
all eleven high-precision response components lie inside their predicted outward intervals
failure_policy: retain failure or unavailable result; do not change geometry, law, scales, observation or precision after response evaluation
limitations: known-source software control, not independent empirical identification
finite high-precision response cross-check is not an interval-certified oracle
the predictor's enclosure is conditional on the exact geometric interval and complete law premises
geometry does not infer the overall dynamic rate scale or physical clock
no microscopic law selection, spontaneous formation or material identification
